problem: An elevator covers $602$ feet in $4$ minutes, moving at a constant rate. What is the speed of the elevator?

feedback.problem: A motorcyclist covers $99$ miles in $3$ hours at a constant rate.  What is the speed of the motorcyclist?
feedback.worked_solution:
Speed is a special unit rate applied to moving objects. It is defined as *the distance traveled per unit of time*:

$$
\text{speed}=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}
$$

To find the speed (in miles per hour), we divide the number of miles, $99,$ by the number of hours, $3.$ This gives,

$$
\frac{99}{3}=99÷3=33.
$$

Therefore, the speed of the motorcyclist is $33$ miles per hour.
